text:
sophie: Hey team, first full draft of the product launch post + benchmark appendix is up for review: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch/draft
matt: Nice! Will skim now. Sophie, can you paste the short bench callouts here so I can double-check claims before outreach?
kevin: Quick note 12: hero reads a bit technical. Suggest swapping "optimized runtime" -> "faster responses" to land with PMs. :thinking_face:

sophie: Good call. Pasting conservative bench highlights from the appendix below:
```
- Latency: 15-30 ms p50 on common prompts (hosted)
- Unit cost: up to 0.9x improvement vs baseline model X (batching + KV cache)
- Throughput: ~2.5x steady-state with batching & cache enabled
```

devon: Ops+GTG. One ops ask: include an explicit fallback rule for Dedicated -> Hosted if capacity hits 90% for 5m. Also add short runbook snippet so oncall can flip it.

sophie: Adding runbook snippet and fallback rule now. Also adding UTM examples for webinar/demo CTAs per growth request.

jenny: Recommend the hero CTA link to demos (we see better MQL convs), put webinar as secondary link.
kevin: +1 for hero -> demo, but keep inline "watch webinar" for nurture channel.

ella: Legal flag: phrase "0.9x improvement" might be interpreted as guaranteed. Please change to "up to 0.9x on typical workloads" or add a footnote with test conditions.

sophie: Reworded to "up to 0.9x unit-cost improvement on typical LLM workloads; see benchmark appendix for test conditions" and linked to appendix. Live doc updated: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch/draft#benchmarks

legalbot: @ella Legal review requested for thread 1714242424: check benchmark language and appendix citation. Please review within 48h.

devon: Ops: added the fallback snippet to the ops runbook (link in doc). Suggest we schedule a short handoff with oncall tomorrow AM.

matt: Ill prep two social blurbs once copy is locked: one product-facing, one technical. Also can someone drop a 1-line exec quote in the doc?

sophie: Added two quote variants and the UTM matrix sample: 
``
CTA -> destination?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=launch_x&utm_medium=referral
hero-demo -> /demo?utm_campaign=launch_demo
hero-webinar -> /webinar?utm_campaign=launch_webinar
```

jenny: Looks good. Timeline check: if legal clears by EOD, we can lock copy and hand to ops for the morning rollout.

kevin: Small copy tweak in the appendix: change "steady-state" -> "sustained throughput" for clarity.

sophie: Done. Thanks everyone. Will circle back when legal confirms and then lock the doc for publish prep. :thumbsup:
